items.title: The article
items.blurb: The small word that carries gender, number and case for the whole noun phrase.

items.title: The noun
items.blurb: Gender, number, the four cases and every declension family, with stress movement and learned forms.

items.title: The adjective
items.blurb: Agreement, the six declension types, position, comparison and the learned adjectives of formal Greek.

items.title: The pronoun
items.blurb: Strong and weak personal pronouns, clitic order, possessives, demonstratives, question words, relatives and indefinites.

items.title: Numerals
items.blurb: Counting, the numbers that decline, ordinals, dates, time, money, fractions and the learned number words.

items.title: The verb I: forms and conjugations
items.blurb: Person endings, the conjugations, the two stems, past tenses, augment, future, subjunctive, imperative and perfect forms.

items.el: Το ρήμα Β΄: χρόνοι, όψη, εγκλίσεις
items.title: The verb II: tense, aspect and mood
items.blurb: What each tense means, the logic of aspect, θα and να, conditionals, wishes, commands and reported speech.

items.el: Το ρήμα Γ΄: φωνή και σύνταξη
items.title: The verb III: voice, objects and verb types
items.blurb: Active and passive, reflexive and deponent verbs, transitivity, objects and cases, impersonal and modal verbs, and how verbs are built.
